data.title: bn-2dh: Define console run eval phases
data.description: Review explicit pre-frame/post-frame eval ordering, legacy alias validation, failure/artifact semantics, process regressions, and documentation/skill updates.

data.body: INFO: Clean, well-tested phase contract. Verified: (1) lifecycle order is independent of flag order — eval_before at oneshot.rs:185 after _init/before stepping, eval_after at :220 after stepping/before captures, with the integration test deliberately reversing CLI order; (2) --eval aliases --eval-after via a shared parse branch, and duplicate post-frame evals are rejected in both spellings/orders; (3) failure asymmetry is correct — pre-frame failure returns 1 before any frame/artifact (empty stdout, no screenshot), post-frame failure still emits captures then errors last; (4) set_draw_tracing at :177 runs after _init but before eval_before, so the command-reference draw-trace claim ('setup, stepped frames, post-frame eval, not _init') is accurate. clippy clean; run_eval_phases + help + oneshot unit tests pass.

data.reason: Explicit eval phase contract is correct and thoroughly tested; clippy clean, focused regressions pass. No CRITICAL/HIGH issues.
Accepted as verification evidence; no source change requested.
